name: Case law: Germany, Bundesverwaltungsgericht
label: Germany case law (Bundesverwaltungsgericht)
coverage: 27200 published decisions of the Bundesverwaltungsgericht, one file and one commit each, dated the day decided; 237740 citations of federal law linked to germany-law (54973 of them pinned to the article's version in force that day; the others are older than germany-law's record).
